description: Issue #54, the other direction: excluding too much is the worse error, because it drops a real target out of scope.allow and the worker is refused for writing what it was told to write. restore.ts is named in prose AND cited under 根拠 — the citation does not retract the instruction, so it stays a target. manager.ts sits under 再現手順, which is deliberately NOT a context heading: a bug report names the file it reproduces in there. Both remain suspected_files and nothing is excluded.
